lines: Every other AI agent starts the same way — a blank box, waiting on you.
You prompt it. You train it. You babysit it. You do the work.
Tell it your industry, and Jordyn arrives already fluent — the words, the paperwork, the deadlines.
Then it reads your inbox and learns your clients, your deals, your voice.
No prompting. It just works — morning briefings, a pipeline that builds itself, replies in your voice.
It even answers your phone, and makes your calls.
Jordyn. Not a tool you operate — an assistant that works. Start free at jordyn dot app.
